title: Config manifest
description: Identifies one published version of the balance config. Every battle record stores the config version it ran on.

config_version.description: Raise by 1 every time a changed config is published. A battle always runs on the version it started with.

schema_version.description: Version of these schema files. Raise it when a field is added, renamed or removed, so old clients can refuse a config they can't read.

label.description: Short human note on what this version changed.
